{{Quote|I've ''been'' there, friend, and those ruins of your&mdash;what'd you call 'em?&mdash;'Sharu,' are the biggest hunks of engineering in the known galaxy. What's more, they cover every body in the system larger than my thumbnail.|Arun Feb|<ref name="sharu" />}}
'''Arun Feb''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who worked as the assistant to supervisor [[Vett Fori]] for an outfit based on [[Oseon 2795]]. A short, stocky man, Feb was relatively well-traveled, having seen the massive, mysterious ruins of the long-vanished [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]], and having beheld [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaurs]] on [[Trammis III/Legends|Trammis III]]. In his off-hours, Feb entertained himself with games of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]&mdash;Feb, Fori and several others played a game with offworld [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. Although Feb left the game before Calrissian completely cleaned him out, he stayed long enough to witness local [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] [[T. Lund Phuna]] attempt to frame Calrissian for cheating and arrest him. Not willing to let Calrissian suffer such injustice, Feb and Fori knocked Phund unconscious and allowed the offworlder to escape.<ref name="sharu" />
